subject: QTR Kickoff: stakeholder handoff & launch-check for OKRs + QBR playbook
messages:
From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@acme.com, partners-team@cloudvendor.com
Date: 2027-04-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: QTR Kickoff: stakeholder handoff & launch-check for OKRs + QBR playbook

Team —

This kicks off the quarter launch cadence between Redwood and Acme. Primary asks: 1) confirm OKR owners and top 3 success metrics per objective, 2) run one internal dry-run of the QBR playbook, and 3) hand off action cards to engineering/product owners by EOD Thursday.

I've attached the first-pass action cards (OKR_action_cards_v0.2.pdf) and a short timeline. High-level plan below: 

- Today: distribute draft action cards to owners, collect initial edits
- Wed: owners make commits + kim to fold operational runbook notes
- Thu: internal dry-run + finalize playbook for Acme readout
- Fri: signoff and schedule QBR run-through with Acme (30m)

Please reply with owner confirmations inline. Marcus — can you validate the latency/cost metric buckets for the Serving runtime objective?

Olga
Olga Petrov | Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
[attachment: OKR_action_cards_v0.2.pdf (pdf)]

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@acme.com
Date: 2027-04-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QTR Kickoff: stakeholder handoff & launch-check for OKRs + QBR playbook

Thanks Olga — quick clarifying Qs: 
- For "top 3 success metrics" do we want absolute targets or relative (week-over-week) thresholds? I recommend absolute for the QBR packet and relative for the cadence checks.
- Are we reusing the same owners from last quarter or will there be new assignments? I can take owner for the "Reduce token cost / inference per request" item if needed.

I flagged a small typo in the action cards (page 2) about rollout window. Will send inline edits shortly.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt | Head of Strategy Operations
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: partners-team@cloudvendor.com
Date: 2027-04-20T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QTR Kickoff: stakeholder handoff & launch-check for OKRs + QBR playbook

Looping in a couple practical items — I've attached my dry-run notes and a trimmed playbook fragment (QBR_playbook_dryrun_notes.docx). Key edits: 

- Add a 5-min incident retrospective slot in the dry-run so we can validate fallback policies
- Standardize metric naming to match the console dashboards ("avg_resp_ms" / "per_token_cost_usd")
- Owners should fill in the "commitment" column in the owner-commitments.csv (I attached a template to the Drive).

Marcus — I agree with Hannah: use absolute targets in the packet. We can show delta vs last quarter as a supplementary slide.

Kim
Kimberly Park | Senior PM, Redwood Console
[attachment: QBR_playbook_dryrun_notes.docx (docx)]

From: ops@acme.com
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QTR Kickoff: stakeholder handoff & launch-check for OKRs + QBR playbook

Thanks — Acme can confirm participation for Thu internal dry-run and Fri signoff. Two asks from our side: 1) can you share the QBR deck template and 2) we prefer a 30-minute prep call with your leads (product + infra) before the dry-run to align on acceptance criteria.

Available windows: Thu 09:30-10:00 or Thu 17:00-17:30 PT. Let us know what works.

— Maya (Acme Ops)
Maya Lopez | Program Manager, Acme Corp
ops@acme.com

From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: ops@acme.com, hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QTR Kickoff: stakeholder handoff & launch-check for OKRs + QBR playbook

Maya — thanks, Thu 17:00 PT works for our team. Sending a calendar invite now (Calendly link below) and attaching the QBR deck template to the Drive.

Action items updated: 
- All owners: complete owner-commitments.csv by Thu 12:00 PT
- Kim: finalize dry-run notes and include incident retrospective slot by Wed 17:00 PT
- Marcus: confirm "avg_resp_ms" buckets and send reference dashboards to the Drive

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-id/QBR-playbook-v1
Calendly (prep call): https://calendly.com/redwood/qbr-prep-30

Olga

From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, ops@acme.com
Date: 2027-04-22T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Final: OKR owners confirmed & QBR dry-run scheduled (signoff)

Quick update — owners have committed and the owner-commitments.csv is populated (see Drive). We ran a short internal preflight this morning; key takeaways: 

- Owners confirmed top-3 metrics and absolute targets for the QBR packet
- Incident retrospective spot added to the dry-run agenda
- Marcus validated dashboard buckets and uploaded sample queries to Drive

We're signed off to proceed with Thu dry-run and Fri external run-through. Attaching the final action cards for the record.

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround — will circulate the runbook notes after Friday's external.

Olga Petrov | Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
[attachment: owner-commitments.csv (csv)]
